rows.text: Aventurine seems to be deliberately bidding against you, making this auction even harder...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: As long as he keeps raising the bid, he plays right into my hands.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Let me see what the next item is... The "Amber Lord's Pardon"?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: ...Aventurine's definitely going to make a move.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Lot number 2, a special prize from the Interastral Peace Corporation's 2000 AE Annual Gala: the Amber Lord's Pardon.
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: *susurrent noises*
rows.speaker: Guests

rows.text: Excellent that everyone's so excited. The legendary "Top 3 Dreams of All IPC Employees" is very real!
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: Whether you've caused a monumental workplace disaster or cost the IPC a fortune... as long as you've been a full-time employee for at least one year, this item grants you a one-time Pardon, absolving you of all accountability and compensation claims.
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: *eager voices*
rows.speaker: Guests

rows.text: (Cast an expectant glance)
The starting bid is 500 million credits. Let the bidding begin!
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: (Is Aventurine really not tempted by this?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Try to shoot Aventurine another look)
Number 3, 510 million. Number 11, 530 million. Can we go higher? 550 million, anyone giving me more?
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: Are there really no IPC employees among us?
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: (I'll go first!)
600 million for Guest 1, who is not even an IPC employee. 600 million, do I have a higher bid? 650 million, Number 5.
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: The "Lucky Chip" Aventurine gave you is vibrating...
(Press on the chip, holding it still)
Can't hold it back. But...
(Pull out the chip to examine it closely)
A line of fine print appears on the back of the chip —
"Please use the Harmony trick and chat with me~"
Guest 1, 700 million. 700 million going once, 700 million going twice... Are there really no higher bids...
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: (Please, Master Aventurine, raise the bid...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Over here, Aventurine, look at me... Raise the bid, A-VEN-TU-RINE!)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I see 750 million. Guest 1 immediately signals 800 million. You're really playing it cool, Guest 7, upping to 1 billion?
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: 800 million going once! 800 million going twice!
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: Guest 7... Oh!? Guest 7 yields! And sold for 800 million! Congratulations to Guest 1 for winning the Amber Lord's pardon!
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: ...At the client's request, slight adjustments will be applied to the upcoming lots. The auction for the next item will resume in 10 minutes.
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: Please take a short break, everyone, while also kindly maintaining {RUBY_B#"private communication strictly prohibited"}etiquette{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: (Brief Robin on his request)
I didn't expect he'd planned to "cheat" right from the start... Let's hear what he has to say.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Now we can speak freely.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: You finally found the lucky fine print.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Why did you suddenly stop raising the bidding price just now? Where is your loyalty to the IPC? The Ten Stonehearts' team spirit? This is way too suspicious!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: And you, why bid to get IPC benefits? Isn't that even more suspicious?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...I—I'm just keeping options open for the future. But you? You'd rather drop 2 billion on a card.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: First of all, it's four cards.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Second of all, I like cards.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Honestly, same.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: It's that obvious?
...Can you two get to the point?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: We're all old friends here, we don't need to play these games.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: That earlier business was purely out of personal interest. What I'm really after comes later...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Let me guess, you — or rather — Miss Robin is after the same thing?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Even though your meaning is not exactly clear, we have no intention of just giving in.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Relax, I mean no harm. I'm only here to tell you that your intentions are really too obvious. They're written all over your face.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Your excitement when the bids shoot up, and disappointment when they are low... That's not the you I know. It doesn't seem you're here to buy. You are here to spend money...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You're in Ratite's challenge, yes?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I probably wouldn't have connected the dots so quickly if I weren't playing Ratite's game too.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...You're playing too?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Oh yes, but I'm doing the "All-You-Can-Buy Challenge."
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Did you really guess all that?
The rules are simple: I have seven days to buy every item on a special "shopping list" in Astropolis.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: These items are not just expensive, they're incredibly rare.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Are you sure you should be talking about this?
At this point, there's no use hiding it.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I'm doing the "All-You-Can-Lose Challenge."
Three days to spend 20 billion credits in Astropolis.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...Isn't that a bit excessive?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Seriously, why is Ratite like this?
Right here, right now... You're on the last day of the challenge. The auction is your final shot, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: And... Mr. Aventurine's "All-You-Can-Buy Challenge" just happens to include the "Lost Echo of Gopher Wood"?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Exactly. This whole thing is a trap set by Ratite.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: One of us is inevitably going to be penalized for failing.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Isn't Ratite worried that since you two know each other, you might coordinate beforehand?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: That's why the first rule of the challenge is... you do not talk about the challenge.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: But how did Ratite know I'd entrust [Trailblazer] with this?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I suspect Ratite deliberately leaked the news about the "Lost Echo of Gopher Wood" appearing in Astropolis...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: But we can't worry about that right now. The auctioneer just got the signal. It looks like the next item is the "Lost Echo of Gopher Wood."
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You need it to spend big, Miss Robin needs its contents, and I need to use it to uncover a secret...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: So, I'd like to propose a deal.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I'll help you drive up the bid so that you win your challenge. Once that's done, would you two mind handing it over to me?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: But... doesn't that mean Mr. Aventurine fails his challenge?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I'd just lose a bit of money, no biggie. Besides, even if I did throw in, with you guys around, the bids definitely wouldn't be cheap.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: When I complete the challenge, I'll split some of the money with you to help lighten your load.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Thanks. That's all I needed to hear.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I second Mr. Aventurine's proposal... [Trailblazer], how much money do you still have left to spend?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: 7.4 billion...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Your attention, please! The auction is about to resume!
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: Come on, [Trailblazer]. It's our turn now to put on a show.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I regret to inform you all that, per the organizer's request, the next lot will be the final item of this auction.
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: It is not an item from Mr. Ratite's personal collection, but from a mysterious client.
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: The "Lost Echo of Gopher Wood."
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: We know very little about it, but the unknown often holds immeasurable value.
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: A value that will be defined by all of you present. Starting bid: 900 million credits.
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: 950 million.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Guest 7 places the first bid... so this is what you've been waiting for!
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: Oh? All eyes turn to Guest 1, another admirer of this lot...
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: Everyone, here's your chance! Number 6 with 980 million... Number 8 with 1 billion.
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: Guest 7, 1.2 billion! 1.2 billion, anyone higher? Still waiting, Guest 1? Where's all that aura from before?
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: Guest 12 with 1.3 billion. Oh, up to 1.4 billion from the back. Do I hear 1.5, Guest 7?
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: Halt! Remote bidder in for 1.6 billion! Guest 7 responds immediately... 1.8 billion! They both mean business!
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: ...Wait, 2 billion again for telephone bidder!
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: 2.5 billion, Guest 1, back in the fray... 3 billion for Guest 7... Phone bidder in with 3.5 billion!
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: Shut up!
rows.speaker: Aventurine & [Trailblazer]

rows.text: With you Guest 1, 4.1 billion. Now 4.3 billion, phone bidder. You look ready to raise me... 4.6, Guest 7!
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: 5 billion!!! Phone bidder hangs up, and what will you give me Guest 7? That's 5.5 billion!!! 1 and 7 are going head-to-head.
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: 6 billion!!! Guest 1 in for 6 billion!!!
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: Number 1, I've put up with you for long enough!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Seven—point—four—billion!!! Guest 7 —
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: Number 7, I've put up with you for long enough, too!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: This busted music box, selling for 6 billion? Are you insane? That, or you're just messing with me.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Um... P—Please if you two... could kindly mind your... auction etiquette.
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: All-You-Can-Lose Challenge: Day 3 Ends
Fine.
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: After the auction concluded, [Trailblazer] settled all payments. Robin walked away with the "Lost Echo of Gopher Wood," and [Trailblazer] and Aventurine parted ways. Their deal is done, no strings attached.
Seems I misplaced it.
Got it, let's go!
Sure!
Zip it!
Nice outfit!
Wait, you're here to bid too?
I bet you don't even have that kind of money! I'll make my final bid. If you can match it, it's yours. I won't go any higher.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I bid 7 billion!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: S—Seven billion?
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: 7.4 billion going once... 7.4 billion going twice...
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: ...Tsk.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Isn't this a mini transmitter...?
A lucky chip? I don't remember that.
And sold! 7.4 billion with Guest 1! Congratulations!!!
rows.speaker: Auctioneer

rows.text: *clapping and whistling sounds*
rows.speaker: Guests

rows.text: Recording ready...

On the very last day, [Trailblazer] actually found the perfect loophole and burned through tens of billions of credits in one go. My goodness, {M#he}{F#she} completely cleaned out the challenge account!
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: But has the challenge really been won?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Next up, our team will rigorously audit the spending records to make absolutely sure the rules were respected and followed to the letter.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Subscribe to Ratite's channel, and all the suspense will be revealed tomorrow! Stay tuned!
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Don't worry, Boss. Aventurine is guaranteed to lose this time. I won't let you down.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Calling me over just to watch this farce? Ratite, you've got a lot of nerve.
I can smell it even through the screen: that reek of shabby pedantry. After all these years, it's still just as nauseating.
That's it? Kid, you've barely won a few pennies off me.
Enough to keep me fed for three days.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: With that card you have, you could win another Fool's mask from me. Put that on, and you can say goodbye to your past for good.
You misunderstand. I turned down the Fools' invitation a long time ago.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: Then why did you even bother playing cards with me?
I wanted to get a closer look at your mask.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: You have the most exquisite mask of all: lined with golden threads and full of jewels. But now that I've gotten a closer look, I see that...
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: It's just another mask.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: Bah! I've never met someone so utterly shameless!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Haven't you had enough fun?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Mr. Aventurine...
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Shut it, bird. I wasn't talking to you.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You're nothing but a puppet. You're not the one who truly enjoys watching money destroy human nature.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Sugilite, you went through all this trouble to see this show we put on. Was it worth the ticket price?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: If you want to have fun, I'll indulge you anytime. But dragging [Trailblazer] into this... is just distasteful.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Or are you afraid that if you don't muddy these waters, I'll see right through whatever you're hiding in your hand?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Hah, a one-on-one game is just too monotonous. It's much livelier with a crowd, isn't it? You were all so into it, why not let me join the fun?
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: Besides, this time, I picked up a scent other than yours...
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: That of a new friend. Even from this side of the screen, I can smell the tantalizing fear rolling off {M#him.}{F#her.}
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: [Trailblazer] is my friend, and {M#he's}{F#she's} under my protection.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: This isn't Penacony, Aventurine. That tragic melodrama of you laying down your life on a gamble won't work on me.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: Tossing your life onto the betting table is something you do with ease. But let's not forget: your fate isn't the only weight sitting on the scales right now.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: Let me treat you to a grand spectacle, Ratite.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: People say that "debt is a very ancient quagmire," because it is slow and agonizing.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: But today, I will show you...
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: That death from debt can also be quite instantaneous.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: Shh... Let's cut the cameras here. Leaving off on a shot of "[Trailblazer] refusing to accept reality" wouldn't be half bad.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Go, pick the clothes you like, then choose your desired identity... and then use them well, child.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Since when did the Ten Stonehearts sink so low as to scour the slums for a successor?
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: You have a problem with it, go take it up with your {RUBY_B#chief}lanor{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: If he had the time to deal with this, I wouldn't be sitting here wearing a mask and stomaching my disgust.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: You think a name change will rid you of your past, like shedding some old clothes? That pretty new outfit does nothing to mask the stench of a pauper.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: Is this the "onboarding" Madam Jade mentioned? Sir, if listening to this earns me more funding from you, I can stand here till dusk.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: That afternoon your master died, what did you put in his tea? Belladonna? Or maybe dumbbell vine, a favorite of your clan? Paranoid and cowardly as he was, he wouldn't have let you anywhere near his tableware during a proper meal.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: You seem to know more about the things left off the record than someone who was actually there.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: He was a kept hyena. It hardly mattered when he got put down. You survived, which proves you are worth more than him.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: You... knew him?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Look at those eyes. Still dreaming, aren't you? Thinking that destiny will finally smile on you just because you climbed up a step?
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: Every gambler believes they can bankrupt the house. It's a pity they always forget they're sitting at the IPC's table... and even their chips are borrowed.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: Penniless boy, your game has only just begun.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: I've played a lot of games, sir. But it's rare for someone to chatter on like this to an opponent they've just met.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Just met? This is exactly why I loathe the poor masses. So tragically ignorant.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: That night, I was sitting right in that corner. You won a few pennies off me, then scurried away, squeezed into the crowd, and sniffed about. The Tavern was practically paved with gold, but you wouldn't even glance at any of it. You only had the guts to scrape up filthy copper coins off the floor.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: I've beaten too many masked freaks. How am I supposed to remember you?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Who would have thought a Fool who toys with people's hearts would learn to wag his tail and beg the IPC for scraps.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: A Fool? Who are you calling something so vulgar and tasteless?
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: The IPC lacks for nothing, least of all money. However, money moves people the most, not when it's piled mountain-high...
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: ...But when it grinds people down to dust. Greed, hope, dignity... they all crumble before true wealth.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: That is the very scene {RUBY_B#Mourning Actors}we{RUBY_E#} spend our entire lives pursuing.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: Some time later, you told Robin the story of your film editing adventure.
Thanks to Miss Robin stepping in, we've managed to dodge Sugilite's "levies," at least for now.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: But on the flip side, now all three of us are completely dragged into Ratite's little game.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I couldn't help but overhear... it seems you've been through a lot yourself, Miss Robin.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Yes. Last night, I received a challenge invitation from Ratite. He challenged me to walk around Astropolis all day without being recognized, while not wearing masks or disguises of any kind.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Frankly it's not that hard to pull off. I could just "play myself." Plus, I'm pretty good with makeup, too.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: But that challenge felt like a sensationalist reality show, so I felt no need to participate.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Next time he asks, just pretend to be Sunday.
We haven't swapped identities since we were children. But I sure would like to see that startled look on my brother's face again, if there is ever a chance.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Next time he asks, just pretend to be Sparkle.
Hehe, then I'd have to make sure I get revenge for last time.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Next time he asks, just pretend to be Acheron.
A second time round? Sounds fun.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Besides, I already had a prior agreement with the two of you. I didn't want to complicate matters, and I certainly didn't want to give Ratite any chance to make waves.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: The birdie really swooped in to save the day this time, so decisive!
Actually, that's all connected to the "Lost Echo of Gopher Wood." Speaking of, I was hoping to hear your thoughts on it.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Back to the present...
If I had found out earlier that The Family was hiding a "suggestion" in my voice, I might have canceled the performance. It would have been the safer choice.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: But these past few days have only made me more certain. I will give my own answer through my song.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Let The Family hear it: Harmony is born of freedom. Even improvised notes can weave together into a moving melody.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Just like an auction.
Miss Robin, have you ever tried surfing?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Between the crests, a surfer has to read every subtle shift in the current beneath their board.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Sometimes it's tame and calm, other times it's turbulent and unpredictable. But you can't learn to find your balance, until you're actually riding the waves.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You asked for that Monopolist Card before the challenge was revealed. If you ask me, Miss Robin, your "improvisation" has already begun.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: *Phone ringtone*
I'm taking this call. You two chat.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Praise be to the Beauty!!!
rows.speaker: Distant Phone Receiver

rows.text: That's so loud...
We don't have much time. Ratite has already announced the "Guess-the-Race-Winner Challenge" across all social media platforms.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: You know what? I might have an idea...
The racing team I bought is qualified to compete in the "Starflux" Grand Prix.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...But unfortunately, it's currently being used as collateral.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I also have some good news on my end.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Mr. Argenti saved my life back in Penacony. As a token of my gratitude, I gave him some funds to invest in a wealth management product.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: And that investment matures today. He called me a moment ago and transferred the principal along with half the profits into my account.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I would not have accepted under normal circumstances. But given the mess we're in... I'm not really in a position to refuse.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Idrila is the most peerless beauty of them all!
I have a plan, and three people are all we need.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Step one, we use these funds to buy back your racing team, [Trailblazer]. As for Miss Robin...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Talk about plot twists.
This makes no sense. Are you trying to cheat us?
You released the episode early?
That wasn't in the contract!
...It's just twenty billion.
But you never gave me that fifty thousand.
This is a malicious setup, and I do not accept!
Why don't we let the audience decide who's refusing to acknowledge their failure?
I really didn't want to resort to violence...
Let the grand twist begin.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Mr. Aventurine, right this way.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Mr. Aventurine, let's say hi to the audience. But wait, where's Miss Robin? She's the one who signed up for the challenge.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Miss Robin has a performance today. She asked me to stand in for her in this guessing game.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Quite the turnout today. Thank you all for your support.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Now this is interesting. You're carrying double the stakes, Mr. Aventurine. You have to win for Miss Robin, and salvage your own reputation. Even with your legendary luck, a second loss would ruin you, wouldn't it?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Attention to all friends just tuning into the stream: The countdown for the "Guess-the-Race-Winner Challenge" has officially begun!
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Tap the link below to face off against the cosmic superstar, Miss Robin.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Entries close 15 minutes before the race starts. Grab this last chance and get on board!
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Some time later, the Starflux race is underway...
...So, with all that said, Mr. Aventurine, which team will you pick?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: I'm afraid I can't disclose that.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Oh? Playing coy, huh! But we all know [Trailblazer]'s team is also competing in this race.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: We have a few more heavyweight guests tuning into the challenge today. Let's patch them through for a quick interview and hear their thoughts.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: It's Ms. Blurry! I heard you actively requested to do this interview. So have you participated in the "Guess-the-Race-Winner Challenge"?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Yes. I'm sure anyone who has read The Fluffy understands one simple truth: The real story only begins the moment you hit rock bottom.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: So your pick is...?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: I'm backing the team with the 10-win streak.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Not [Trailblazer]? What a rational choice.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: And that home team.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: And that legacy powerhouse team.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: How many accounts do you have?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: And the little raccoon team.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I'm sure readers of "The Fluffy" know this to be true, too: Opportunity favors those who cast a wide net. I've been registering new accounts nonstop, even while we're talking. Each alt account represents a chance at 500 credits.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Hello to the Astral Express family... Hmm, is the signal okay? How come we can't see anyone?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Uh, care to introduce yourself?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Winged Deathknell.
Well, Mr. "Winged Deathknell," what a name... If I may be so bold, are you in any way related to Robin...?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Yikes. I can't see his face, but somehow his gaze feels brutal... Are we interviewing an extreme fan or something?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Don't worry. His methods are even more brutal than his gaze.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Hurt [Trailblazer], and we'll make you pay double.
That singing... It's Robin's voice!
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Hurt Robin... I'll make you pay, multiplied by your follower count.

Everyone, please welcome the renowned investment expert, one of the Ten Stonehearts, and the colleague to Mr. Aventurine... Miss Topaz! Alongside the famous mystic and Xianzhou diviner, Miss Qingque. Let's hear what these two have to say.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Don't worry, Aventurine. I'll bet against you. This way we're covered whatever the result.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: ...What, to hedge a 500-credit risk?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: What we're seeing here is the team spirit of the Ten Stonehearts. And which team will Miss Qingque pick?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: If you stepped out left foot first today, I suggest you go with the red one. Right foot first, go with the blue. If you hopped out on both feet, skip buying altogether and head to see the Xianzhou Alchemy Commission... Oh, and, whatever you pick, don't pick white. It's way too bare and has zero style...
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Ah, authentic Xianzhou-style mysticism...
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Hmph. What a ridiculous analysis.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: A true expert would advise against opportunism.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: Um, excuse me, we're in the middle of an interview here. You are...?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: I'm an expert in gambling addiction. Are your hands itching again, gambler? Put those cards away.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: Wh—Who are you? Why are you targeting me? Who are you trying to scare with that plaster head?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Don't worry, he's targeting me.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Where did all these random people come from...!? Hold on! Our reporter on the scene says [Trailblazer] has already arrived at the arena.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Let's switch the feed over right now.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Hello to all our friends in the audience! I'm Carmella, intern reporter for Interastral Peace Entertainment.
rows.speaker: Carmella

rows.text: Right next to me is the new proud owner of team "Prodigal GP," [Trailblazer]. Say hi to the audience!
rows.speaker: Carmella

rows.text: Hi everyone.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Just a quick note: "Prodigal GP" is a thing of the past. That was the former owner's name.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: So what's the team called now?
rows.speaker: Carmella

rows.text: Team Pick-Me.
Haven't decided yet.
If {M#he}{F#she} risks flooring it to cut off "Rich Bird Racing" right at the finish line, and lets the cars behind catch up, we can pull off the miracle where "everybody wins"!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Team Pick-Me, as in, you know, "pick me."
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The day of Guess-the-Race-Winner Challenge
Ah, yes. And the floor here is made of floor.
rows.speaker: Carmella

rows.text: Actually we haven't decided yet. For now, let's call it... Custom Name 4? Or maybe Team Pick-Me?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Let's go with the latter. At least it sounds like you tried.
rows.speaker: Carmella

rows.text: Word on the street is that your esteemed team doesn't even have a proper driver. No wonder no one dares to bet on you.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: That position is currently open...
Never mind the driver...
The boss here is just warming up...

Funny you should mention that! Huge thanks to Mr. Ratite for offering up his stream as the perfect recruitment platform. Our driver position is now open for hire: top pay, zero experience needed, first come, first served!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Never mind the driver, we literally have nothing here but cars. Is it too late to back out now?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Worry not, my friends. Just pick us. Your boss here is just getting warmed up!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: My, my. Quite the elaborate setup for an "ace in the hole."
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Let me give you a piece of financial advice: Don't invest in your best friend.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Here's a piece of advice for you, too: Don't play games with your boss's rival.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Exactly.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Heh, let's see how long you can keep up this tough act.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Oh? Miss Robin, the star of our challenge, is also joining us...
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: It's already packed like sardines out here!
rows.speaker: Carmella

rows.text: Miss Robin, I like you...
rows.speaker: Crazed Fan

rows.text: Miss Robin is as composed as ever... I just wonder how long that composure will last.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Miss Robin, please say hello to everyone in the stream~
rows.speaker: Carmella

rows.text: Thank you all for your support. Wow... So many of you are participating in the predictions.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Feel free to choose your favorite team, everyone! Please don't be pressured in any way.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: By the way, can you elaborate on that mysterious teaser you gave at the opening ceremony?
rows.speaker: Carmella

rows.text: During the competition, I'll be debuting a brand-new, unreleased song. Please look forward to it!
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Wow! Did you all hear that? Make sure you don't go anywhere during the race!
rows.speaker: Carmella

rows.text: Your proxy, Mr. Aventurine, is right next to me. Mr. Aventurine, is there anything you'd like to say to Miss Robin?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: I'm going to run rings around this noisy, stupid bird right here.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You have my full support.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Ratite, feel free to edit that bit out if it's too much for you.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Edit what out!? We're live!
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Ahaha, my apologies then.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Miss Robin, your friend [Trailblazer]'s team is also competing today. So what do you think is the most important element in a race?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Team radio, of course. That's the real highlight when it comes to team tactics.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Oh? It sounds like Miss Robin is... hinting at something.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: That's all from here on the ground!
rows.speaker: Carmella

rows.text: ...Welcome back to the stream.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: The betting window for the "Guess-the-Race-Winner Challenge" will close in 5 minutes. Mr. Aventurine, have you still not decided?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: May the Lotto Goddess bless me. It's about time I won some...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Cut the feed.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Mr. Ratite, why do you seem more anxious than I am?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Is it because you've rigged the race to end a certain way?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: How could I? This is a live broadcast across the entire network. If I were to get caught doing something like that, I'd be finished.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Oh I see. So if you don't get caught, you're fine with cheating?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: How is that any different from a presumption of guilt? Accusing me requires real evidence, not just empty words.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Then why don't you guess which team I'm going to pick?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Mr. Aventurine, you wanna use this opportunity to turn the tables, that I can understand. Choosing a popular team offers a lower return, which would be meaningless to you.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: For that reason, I think you will choose "Team Pick-Me." It's got the greatest risk, thus the highest return.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: You know a gambler's mindset better than I do.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: What is with all these oddballs and weird birds today? Let's connect to our final group.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Given how you set me up in the previous two rounds, how could you possibly give me a genuine answer?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You're simply baiting me into making a certain choice.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: "Rich Bird Racing," "Scuderia Cosmo," or even "Team Pick-Me"... You can manipulate any team into winning the race.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: But it will never be the one I bet on.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: The moment I place my bet, I step right into your trap.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: But the betting time is almost up. I'd hate to keep the viewers waiting, so let's get started.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Do you remember this Monopolist Card?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You said it yourself, this "Purchase Card" creates a "Purchasable Item." Even if it's dirt on Louis Fleming that I wish to purchase, you'll make it happen.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I—Isn't this the card from the last round of challenges?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: It is, but the rules never stated it couldn't be used in a different challenge, no?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: This is against convention!
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Convention? You don't get to decide that. Sugilite, you're listening in, right? This game is getting stale. Don't be a buzzkill and say "no" to me too. What do you say we shake things up a little?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: The boss approved... He said you can use it.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Tsk, darn it... So what do you want to buy with it?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Choosing a team is like tossing a coin, except whichever side lands up, the coin's gonna land right in your trap.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: So I'm betting on the coin standing on its edge.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Standing on its edge?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Entrusted with full authority by Miss Robin, the outcome I am crafting and locking my wager on... is this:
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Either everybody wins, or nobody does.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: The betting for the "Guess-the-Race-Winner Challenge" has now closed.
rows.speaker: System

rows.text: Time is up. Whatever outcome you envisioned, it can no longer be modified.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: To everyone tuning in, let's take a look at the final breakdown of the bets:
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Thanks to Mr. Aventurine's stroke of genius, there isn't a single matching bet on the board.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Which means Miss Robin is either going to crush the entire competition... or be absolutely crushed by them!
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Now, let's take a look at the prize pool breakdown for the possible outcomes:
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: With roughly 200 million active fans placing their bets, that means...
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: If Miss Robin wins, she'll walk away with 100 billion credits straight from yours truly, Ratite! But if she loses, she'll be the one shelling out a hundred billion credits to sponsor her fans!
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: What an absolute thrill! Don't go anywhere, folks. Right after this short commercial break, we'll hand the broadcast back over to our professional commentators.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Welcome back, viewers, to the Starflux live broadcast! I'm your commentator, Crafty.
rows.speaker: Commentator Crafty

rows.text: And I'm your commentator, Brundie. We're midway through the race now, and the battle on the track is still tight as can be!
rows.speaker: Commentator Brundie

rows.text: That's right! The lead cars are practically glued to each other. The gap between them is under a single second!
rows.speaker: Commentator Crafty

rows.text: Team Pick-Me is looking for an opening to attack, but the car ahead is putting up an ironclad defense! They're giving them absolutely no room to pull out!
rows.speaker: Commentator Brundie

rows.text: Your "Purchase Card" certainly caused a little hiccup, but that's about it.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: That's about it, you say?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Team Pick-Me attempts another pass on the outside... Ah, just not enough room!
rows.speaker: Commentator Brundie

rows.text: Tsk.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Hahahaha! Did you seriously think I wouldn't notice? Your finger snap was way too deliberate.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: I think you're overthinking this.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You're sending signals. Every time you snap, Team Pick-Me's driver gets a tactical command. That last one was a "switchback entry," wasn't it?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: You amateurs probably didn't know this, but the team's radio is a public frequency. Every single move you make, everyone can hear it loud and clear.
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Or is the snapping just a smokescreen, and you're actually plotting something else over the team radio?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Keep guessing.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Look at you, still talking tough. I'll make a deal with you, Mr. Aventurine. If you drop to your knees right now in front of the entire stream, I might just consider wiping half your debt... How about it? Quite the bargain, wouldn't you say?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: We've just received word from the organizers...
rows.speaker: Commentator Crafty

rows.text: To all our viewers tuning into Starflux, you're in for a massive treat! Next up, we'll let Miss Robin's brand-new single carry us through the rest of this thrilling race!
rows.speaker: Commentator Brundie

rows.text: The show is about to begin.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Alright, the feed is back! We're heading into the final laps, and the situation on the track has completely changed!
rows.speaker: Commentator Crafty

rows.text: Yes! All the cars are... they're gradually lining up! They're practically neck and neck! I have never seen anything like this!
rows.speaker: Commentator Brundie

rows.text: Could this actually be what he meant by "either everybody wins, or nobody does"?
rows.speaker: Commentator Crafty

rows.text: I guess if you stay in the commentary box long enough, you really do get to see it all.
rows.speaker: Commentator Crafty

rows.text: Is this The Family's doing? Is her singing affecting the racers over the team radio?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: No, I don't think that's tuning. And it certainly isn't manipulation...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: At this rate, every single car is going to cross the finish line at the exact same time! it's gonna be a multi-way tie for first!
rows.speaker: Commentator Brundie

rows.text: One hundred billion credits. That's a staggering figure. Even here in Astropolis, you'd be hard-pressed to find anyone else who could casually cough up that kind of cash.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You didn't honestly believe Sugilite would foot the bill for a fool like you, did you?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: A hundred billion... a hundred billion... Ahhh... how could this happen!?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Oh my, to think I've been completely outplayed by a masterful sleight of hand from the Aventurine of Stratagems...
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Did you think I was going to say that!? Nope!
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: I knew you were going to try something funny, so I kept a little something up my sleeve, too...
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Wait... things have just taken another dramatic turn!
rows.speaker: Commentator Brundie

rows.text: The "Rich Bird Racing" car has suddenly broken away from the pack! Its engine is smoking!
rows.speaker: Commentator Crafty

rows.text: I rigged that car well in advance. In the final stretch, that "Rich Bird Racing" car will go out of control! Even if it has to ram every last one of you off the track, or go up in flames itself, it will cross that finish line at maximum speed!
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: The moment any car crosses the line first, you lose everything. The game is mine to win!
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Tasting defeat right when victory is within your grasp... That despair must be exceptionally bitter, wouldn't you say, Mr. Aventurine?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: So you finally showed your hand.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Wh—What?
rows.speaker: Ratite

rows.text: Hah. You seem to misunderstand the situation. We've been waiting for this exact moment: when you thought you had it in the bag.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: When you focused all your attention entirely on Miss Robin and me, you were bound to overlook something far more important...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Ratite, those smug little schemes of yours were nothing more than a minor interlude in this race.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: The real "trump card" that decides the outcome has been on the track all along.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Miss Robin's voice has already "set the tone" for this race. Next, [Trailblazer] will go all out to catch up with "Rich Bird Racing." And from this moment on...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: [Trailblazer]'s thirst for victory will become the brightest note in the song, echoing in the ears of every driver and writing a melody of "shared victory" for this race.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Now's the time! [Trailblazer], I'm betting every last dime on you!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Cue my execution theme.
Wake up, Ratite. Time to pay up.
...Edit videos.
...The footage review room.
I wondered how you'd keep tabs on me, and how you'd judge my actions.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Some time later, somewhere in Astropolis...
And then I knew. It's actually quite simple: Just assign an anonymous, independent evaluator to shadow me.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: So, Miss Siobhan, is this the real reason you came to work as a temporary assistant? To see how I'd handle your gift... or rather, your test?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Or have you been watching me since long before that?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Don't get me wrong, I'm just a middlewoman. Besides, I was perfectly willing to share your burdens. I'd say I was a fairly dedicated assistant, wouldn't you agree?
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: If I had known, I would've asked you to reject The Family on my behalf. But I suppose this was also part of your assessment?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Yes. The Family might sweep this under the rug publicly, but internally, everyone is going to know exactly where you stand from now on.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: That's fine. It's something I'll have to face sooner or later anyway.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: You accepted our gift and broke free from The Family's chains, following your own free will. You answered us with your song, a true "improvisation."
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: To me, singing should be about "setting the tone," rather than a simple "tuning."
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: And that's exactly what we're looking for: another possibility for the Harmony.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: Miss Robin, congratulations on passing the initiation test. We invite you to join the "Blues Brigade."
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: Are you willing to inherit Mr. Gopher Wood's title of "CHORUS" and become a member of the "Blues Brigade"?
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: The Brigade wants to hear a variety of voices, not a monotonous chant. We would never restrict our members' "freedom."
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: I'm honored to be recognized by the Brigade...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: But the Brigade hasn't earned my recognition yet.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I don't see this as a one-way gift, but a two-way choice.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Mr. Gopher Wood might have left The Family, but he never walked the true path of Harmony, either.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: If the Brigade simply provides shelter for those who reject The Family, then I'm afraid our visions for the future don't quite align.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Going through all of this has made me realize something. The Family's blueprint, your invitation... none of that really matters.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: What helped me find my {RUBY_B#fate}rhythm{RUBY_E#} again, was that carefree sea breeze and those syncopated notes.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Carefree sea breeze, huh.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: Your sponsor, "SWING," was right. You aren't easily swayed.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: Your heart will always beat for the people, and your wings are destined to soar even beyond these skies.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: Maybe this is what "freedom" is supposed to be.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: Leaving your seat before the show's over? I guess this little game in Astropolis wasn't enough to hold your attention, Sugilite.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Meanwhile, somewhere in Astropolis...
During the disciplinary vote to strip me of my seat among the Ten Stonehearts, you were the first to vote in favor.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: That's far from the only resolution I've voted "yes" on. How else would I get to see the looks on everyone's faces?
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: Besides, my vote was far from unjust. You never took the Cornerstone seriously to begin with.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: Who would have guessed that Penacony's "Dreammaster" would entrust the secrets of the Harmony to one of the Ten Stonehearts? Had I known you two were so chummy, I wouldn't have had to smash a Cornerstone over it.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Are you that upset you couldn't squeeze what Diamond wanted out of me?
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: Crossing off an option isn't a waste of time. What about you, though? You didn't get to see me crash and burn, yet again. Aren't you disappointed?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I knew we weren't cut from the same cloth the first time I laid eyes on you. I've seen way too many upstarts like you in the Strategic Investment Department, climbing the ladder on sheer luck.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: You barely managed to prove yourself this time. But if the day comes when you show your true colors like the rest of them...
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: The scales will tip, the sword will fall, and you won't be nearly as lucky.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: And there's something I could never figure out. When it comes to wealth, hardly anyone in the Ten Stonehearts holds a candle to you, yet you've been sitting at the bottom rank all these years. Now I get it.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: This way, anyone trying to join the ranks of the Stonehearts has to step over the threshold known as "Sugilite" and face your scrutiny.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: For Diamond, you're filtering people out, testing those given the name of a "Stoneheart" to see if they can bear the weight of a Cornerstone. And for yourself, wealth, status... you get whatever you want.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Life doesn't thrill you anymore. Watching the tragic downfall of others is the only way to fill the empty heart of a Mourning Actor.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I'm still happy about the choice I made years ago. A sip of the Elation's fine wine every now and then is great. But even someone like you, aren't you still wearing a mask, playing whatever part Diamond hands you?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: These days, even the Tavern doesn't welcome Actors anymore. What better stage to sit back and watch a tragedy unfold than the IPC?
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: If you ask me, this show is far from over. Why don't we check in on our other colleagues? Two more of the Ten Stonehearts are about to pay {RUBY_B#Astral Express}your old friend{RUBY_E#} a visit.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: I had no idea. Who will it be this time?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Obsidian and Opal.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: ...Why send them?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Don't ask questions you already know the answers to. If there's a good cop, there has to be a bad cop too.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: You know exactly how those two operate. They either get what they want, or they burn it to the ground.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: I can't wait to see how you choose, Aventurine.
rows.speaker: Sugilite

rows.text: (I'm supposed to meet Aventurine and Robin at the team's garage. They should be there by now, right?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Thanks to Mr. Aventurine pulling some strings, the paperwork for the prize money is already sorted.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: The Foundation called me three times to triple-check if I was fully awake when I wrote down that number...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Understandable, though. Even after clearing the debt, there's a pretty hefty amount left. And Miss Robin donated every last credit to the Foundation.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I could not have done it without your immense support.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: It's the least we could do. [Trailblazer], what are you going to do with the rest of your cut?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: The secret to "happy spending" is actually pretty simple: It's all about fulfilling your true needs.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: If treating yourself turns into a task, it becomes joyless and burdensome.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: So this time, I'm going to be a little "selfish." I'll spend it if I feel like it, and I won't if I don't.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Even minus the debt, you've still got tens of billions in hand... Sounds like you've got a plan though?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I don't know when it started, but the Astral Express keeps ending up in the craziest of situations...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Getting blown up, getting rammed, cars detaching left and right, at times turning into the horizon's echo... you name it.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: So my top priority is getting the Astral Express covered.
